name: Mato Grosso (Sorriso)
source: INCRA, Atlas do Mercado de Terras 2025 (reference December 2024), bare-land value (VTN) for the MT Centro region (Sorriso, Sinop, Lucas do Rio Verde): R$ 56,860.81/ha, as cited by Investidor Rural; converted at 5.40 BRL/USD. Bare-land value is not a market price. Rent not checked.
_review: Provisional: secondary citation of an official bare-land value; market reports range from R$ 40,000 to R$ 100,000/ha.
